FROM nvidia/cuda:{{cuda_version}}-cudnn-runtime-ubuntu22.04

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y python{{python_version}} python3-pip git && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /workspace

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .
CMD ["python", "train.py"]
